statement: The cited 2008 Chatterjee Section 12(3) question concerns improving the fluctuation exponent beyond the logarithmic variance gain for M_n, the Gaussian zero-temperature up/right path maximum in 1+1 dimensions; the intake's Var(log Z_n) in general dimension is not the cited statement.
assumptions: Source identity arXiv:0810.4221v2; model and M_n as defined in Section 8.
source: https://arxiv.org/pdf/0810.4221, Section 8/Theorem 8.1 and Section 12(3); intake problems.jsonl line 120
proof_or_counterexample: Direct comparison of the primary source's model, theorem, and question with the intake record; no proof of an exponent claim.
remaining_gap: Different-model referee must confirm the source correction before store promotion; current openness remains unknown.
